claims: Forecasters predict an El Niño pattern will develop in summer 2026.
Forecasters predict an El Niño pattern will persist through the end of 2026.
Forecasters predict an El Niño pattern has potential to become a "super El Niño".
The shift from La Niña to El Niño is expected to bring increased rain to the U.S. South.
The shift from La Niña to El Niño is expected to enhance severe weather risks.
The shift from La Niña to El Niño is expected to potentially reduce Atlantic hurricane activity.
